cases.explain: Сестра is the grammatical subject of звалась (was called), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: часто целый день одна сидела молча у ___
cases.translation: Often she sat alone all day silently by the window
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/by) always governs the genitive case, so окно becomes окна.

cases.translation: She did not know how to be affectionate to her father
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) always requires the dative case, so отец becomes отцу.
Судьбу is the direct object of the transitive verb благословил (blessed), so it takes the accusative.
Шкафы is the plural direct object of the transitive verb отворил (opened), an inanimate accusative that matches the nominative form.

cases.sentence: Господский дом уединенный, горой от ветров огражденный, стоял над ___
cases.translation: The secluded manor house, shielded from the winds by a hill, stood above the little river
cases.explain: The preposition над (above) governs the instrumental case, so речка becomes речкой.

cases.translation: He listened to Lensky with a smile
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'with' governs the instrumental case, so улыбка becomes улыбкой.
The preposition в indicating static location requires the prepositional case, so покой becomes покое.
